contracts.commit_point: get_agent().invoke({...}) at llm.py:255-257 — the first guarded effect commit reachable only after the gate; a proactive chat reaching this line has committed the forbidden overlapping or non-deferred agent run.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Module-level concurrency guard registered at llm.py:119-122 (_chat_lock threading.Lock, _chat_state_lock threading.Lock, _pending_user_requests counter). User requests increment the counter under _chat_state_lock (226-228) and acquire _chat_lock blocking (242-244); proactive requests re-check _pending_user_requests under _chat_state_lock and return None (233-236), then attempt a non-blocking _chat_lock.acquire and return None on failure (238-241). Release is guaranteed in the finally block only when acquired (313-315), with counter decrement under _chat_state_lock (316-318).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A proactive chat invocation passing the acquisition gate and proceeding to the agent invoke while either (a) _pending_user_requests > 0 as checked under _chat_state_lock (llm.py:233-236), or (b) _chat_lock.acquire(blocking=False) fails because another chat (user or proactive) holds _chat_lock (llm.py:238-241); equivalently, any overlapping execution of llm.chat bodies or proactive execution that is not deferred to a pending user request.

contracts.protection_obligation: Proactive (source='proactive') llm.chat invocations are forbidden from invoking the LLM agent while any user chat request is pending or while another chat invocation holds _chat_lock: all chat executions are serialized under one module-level lock, user input takes priority over proactive dialogue, and proactive callers (e.g., the email poller) must honor the None return by skipping the proactive run. The two supplied opinions state the same obligation and are merged.

The pending-request check (llm.py:233-236) and the non-blocking acquire (llm.py:238) are separate critical sections; a user request arriving between them blocks on _chat_lock (llm.py:243) rather than preempting the in-flight proactive run.
